svg.title: Amazon Reviews
svg.desc: Amazon Reviews. A big-data pipeline over Amazon product reviews. Three Hadoop MapReduce jobs aggregate reviews, rank products by category and flag anomalies; the same pipeline runs in Spark and is served through a REST API. Built with Java, Hadoop, Spark, Python, Docker.
